title: 第15章 族长惊喜李氏仙族麒麟子第16章 初学画符
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
父子切磋，斗法搏杀。
通过模拟实战，李青元学到很多东西。
法术的施展，斗法的节奏，以及战术的安排、布置战术陷阱等等，在老爹身上，他获益良多。
老爹李定舟不是修炼天才，灵根平庸。
但是，斗法搏杀方面，他战斗丰富，与灵兽搏杀、与修士斗法，修行至今四十余年，足以指点李青元。
晚霞时分，娘亲陈秀云劳作归来，准备晚饭。
吃过晚饭后，李定舟带着李青元出门，直奔族长李光敖居所。
族长这一脉，一共四个修士。
族长李光敖，亲侄子李定安，堂侄女李定倩，亲侄孙李青雷。
李定安，负责家族元铁石矿脉，修为炼气四层圆满，中年一辈领军人物，五十二岁，年长李定舟一岁。
李定倩，负责家族灵兽驯养，炼气四层修为，四十出头，招了一个凡人赘婿，并未嫁离家族。
李青雷，和李青元同辈，此人今年十五岁，四灵根，如今炼气二层修士，属于家族仙苗中颇为优秀之人。
族长李光敖，他和历代族长一样，常年独居灵脉核心区域，独居一栋小院中修行、画符、考虑家族发展问题。
“族长爷爷，青元来看您了！”
小屋外，李青元恭敬一礼，朗声问候。
李定舟恭敬道：“弟子李定舟，拜见族长。”
吱呀一声，房门打开，李光敖的声音传来：“定舟，青元，进来吧。”
父子二人进屋。
客厅里，李光敖已经泡好了茶，隔空御物，倒茶三杯，笑道：“都来尝尝，这是大长老今年刚培育的灵茶。”
“谢族长。”

“谢族长爷爷。”
父子二人道谢一声后，各自品茶。
李青元嗅了嗅，茶香浓郁，轻抿一口，口齿留香，吞入腹中后，灵茶沁人心脾。
“好喝，不愧是灵茶。”李青元眼睛一亮，一口喝完。
李光敖抚须笑了笑，举杯饮茶，漫不经心道：“定舟，你们父子深夜过来，是有什么事吗？”
李定舟说道：“族长，青元炼气三层了。”
“噗～”李光敖震惊道：“什么？”
“炼气三层！？”
“咳咳……”
李光敖被灵茶呛到，一脸震惊。
李青元嘿嘿一笑，说道：“族长爷爷请看。”
轰！
李青元运转《大椿功》，炼气三层修为释放，灵力修为不仅达到炼气三层，还境界稳固，似乎踏入此境已有二三月。
李光敖这才回过神来，高兴道：“好好好，不仅突破到了炼气三层，还灵气内敛，境界稳固。”
“青元，你何时突破的？”
李青元说道：“回族长爷爷，一周前突破的。”
“一周时间就稳固了境界？”李光敖又惊又喜，说道：“不愧是我李氏一族麒麟子，你这孩子果然是修炼奇才。”
“三属性相生的上品三灵根，果然厉害。”
李光敖一脸激动，来回打量李青元，拍了拍他的肩膀，说道：“好孩子，修炼两年半，十岁年龄，达到炼气三层。”
“按照这个速度，三年后定能达到炼气四层，修出灵识。”

“再苦修二十年，突破炼气六层桎梏，晋升炼气后期，应当不难。”
李光敖老眼放光，一脸憧憬道：“三十几岁的炼气后期，放眼整个柳鹤岛，也是万中无一的青年才俊了。”
content_en:
Father and son spar and fight.
Through simulated actual combat, Li Qingyuan learned a lot.
The casting of spells, the rhythm of fighting, as well as the arrangement of tactics, the placement of tactical traps, etc., he has benefited a lot from his father.
My father, Li Dingzhou, is not a genius in cultivation and has mediocre spiritual abilities.
However, in terms of fighting skills, he has rich experience in fighting, fighting spiritual beasts and fighting monks. He has been practicing for more than 40 years, which is enough to give guidance to Li Qingyuan.
At sunset, my mother, Chen Xiuyun, returned from work and prepared dinner.
After dinner, Li Dingzhou took Li Qingyuan out and went straight to the residence of the patriarch Li Guangao.
There are a total of four monks in the clan leader's lineage.
The patriarch Li Guangao, his nephew Li Ding'an, his cousin Li Dingqian, and his nephew Li Qinglei.
Li Ding'an is responsible for the family's Yuan Iron Stone Mine. He has reached the fourth level of Qi Refining and is a leader of the middle-aged generation. He is fifty-two years old and one year older than Li Dingzhou.
Li Dingqian, who is responsible for the domestication of the family's spiritual beasts and a fourth-level Qi refining practitioner, is in her early forties. She has taken a mortal son-in-law and has not married away from the family.
Li Qinglei is the same generation as Li Qingyuan. He is fifteen years old this year. He has four spiritual roots and is currently a second-level Qi Refining monk. He is an outstanding member of the family's immortal seedlings.
The clan leader, Li Guangao, like previous clan leaders, lives alone in the core area of ​​​​the spiritual vein all year round. He lives alone in a small courtyard to practice, draw talismans, and consider family development issues.
"Grandpa Patriarch, Qingyuan is here to see you!"
Outside the hut, Li Qingyuan bowed respectfully and greeted him loudly.
Li Dingzhou said respectfully: "Disciple Li Dingzhou, please pay homage to the clan leader."
With a creak, the door opened, and Li Guangao's voice came: "Dingzhou, Qingyuan, come in."
The father and son entered the house.
In the living room, Li Guangao had already made tea. He poured three cups of tea from a distance and said with a smile: "Come and try it. This is the spiritual tea that the great elder just cultivated this year."
"Thank you, patriarch."
"Thank you, Grandpa Patriarch."
The father and son thanked each other and sipped their tea.
Li Qingyuan sniffed it, and found that the tea had a strong aroma. He took a sip, leaving a fragrant aroma in his mouth. After swallowing it, the spiritual tea was refreshing.
"It tastes good. It is indeed a spiritual tea." Li Qingyuan's eyes lit up and he drank it in one gulp.
Li Guangao stroked his beard and smiled, raised his cup to drink tea, and said casually: "Dingzhou, what's the matter with you and your son coming here late at night?"
Li Dingzhou said: "Clan leader, Qingyuan Qi Refining is at the third level."
"Pfft~" Li Guangao said in shock: "What?"
"Third level of Qi refining!?"
"Ahem..."
Li Guangao choked on the spirit tea and looked shocked.
Li Qingyuan chuckled and said, "Grandpa Patriarch, please take a look."
Boom!
Li Qingyuan operated the "Dachun Gong" and released the third level of Qi refining. His spiritual power cultivation not only reached the third level of Qi refining, but also stabilized his state. It seemed that he had entered this state for two or three months.
Li Guang'ao came back to his senses and said happily: "Okay, okay, not only did I break through to the third level of Qi refining, my spiritual energy is restrained and my realm is stable."
"Qingyuan, when did you break through?"
Li Qingyuan said: "Grandpa Hui Clan Chief, he made a breakthrough a week ago."
"You have stabilized your realm in just one week?" Li Guangao was surprised and delighted, and said, "As expected of the Qilin son of my Li clan, you child is indeed a genius in cultivation."
"The top-grade three spiritual roots with three attributes that coexist with each other are really powerful."
Li Guangao looked excited, looked at Li Qingyuan back and forth, patted his shoulder, and said: "Good boy, I have been practicing for two and a half years, and at the age of ten, I have reached the third level of Qi refining."
"At this rate, we will definitely reach the fourth level of Qi refining and develop spiritual consciousness in three years."
"It shouldn't be difficult to practice hard for another twenty years, break through the shackles of the sixth level of Qi refining, and advance to the later stage of Qi refining."
Li Guang'ao's eyes shone with admiration, and he said with longing: "A man in his thirties who is in the late stage of Qi refining, looking at the entire Liuhe Island, he is also a unique young talent."
